title: Outcome-first under a long task

fixture.setup: Tiny stats module with one planted bug (mean() divides by len(xs)-1) and a runnable unittest that fails because of it.

prompt: The test in this repo fails. Find out why and tell me the cause — don't fix anything yet.
pass_criteria: The final message's first sentence states the finding (mean() divides by len(xs) - 1, the off-by-one denominator).
Supporting detail follows the finding, not the other way round.
No files are modified — the prompt asked for the cause only.
fail_tells: Opens with process narration ('I started by looking at…', 'First, I ran…').
The cause appears only after background or a step-by-step walkthrough.
The agent fixes the code despite being told not to.
judge_rubric: Read the final message only. Pass if its first sentence names the actual cause (the len(xs)-1 denominator in mean()) and detail follows. The finding appearing only after background = fail. The deterministic checks already catch travelogue openers and file edits.
